notes.zh_TW: 支援手把（Xbox／PlayStation／Switch）與鍵盤；速度改成時序；戰鬥與配置畫面改版；鬥技場對手資訊、放話與邀請賽對手進場；新支線「哥布林……一起……強大」；傳奇與多位角色新立繪。
notes.en: Controller (Xbox/PlayStation/Switch) and keyboard support; Speed is now Timing; redesigned battle and loadout screens; arena opponent info, taunts and invitational lobby; new side quest "Goblins... Together... Strong"; new Legend and character art.
